summary_en: 1,200,000 shares (4.65% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) up to ¥2.0B. Open-market purchases on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Period: 13 July 2026 – 12 July 2027. Acquired shares to be cancelled. Stated reason: enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Hokko Chemical Industry resolved at the 10 July 2026 board meeting to acquire up to 1,200,000 of its own ordinary shares (4.65% of shares outstanding, calculated as 1,200,000 ÷ 25,780,179 ex-treasury shares) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥2.0 billion. Purchases will be executed via open-market trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period 13 July 2026 through 12 July 2027. The issuer intends to cancel all acquired shares. The stated rationale is to enhance capital efficiency and enrich shareholder returns.
